# Rootmoss

> A plain folder of Markdown files that gives your AI agent a permanent
> memory it reads first. No account, no subscription — your files stay
> on your disk, never inside a chat vendor's memory. Open source, MIT
> licensed.

Rootmoss is a GitHub template. You clone it, open the folder in any coding
agent that reads `AGENTS.md` (OpenCode, Claude Code, or similar), and the
agent starts every chat already knowing your profile, your decisions and
your notes. Nothing is ever deleted: outdated notes are marked, not lost.

## Start here

- [Landing page](https://siagimir.github.io/rootmoss/): what it is, why it
  matters and how it works
- [First-time tour](https://github.com/siagimir/rootmoss/blob/main/FIRST-TIME-HERE.md):
  the guided 15-minute setup
- [README](https://github.com/siagimir/rootmoss/blob/main/README.md): the
  full documentation
- [Use this template](https://github.com/siagimir/rootmoss/generate): make
  your own copy

## Key concepts

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/siagimir/rootmoss/blob/main/AGENTS.md) —
  the instruction file the agent reads first
- [USER.md](https://github.com/siagimir/rootmoss/blob/main/USER.md) — a
  short profile of you
- `memory/` — six typed folders: facts, preferences, decisions,
  assumptions, lessons, context
- `topics/` — one folder per area of your life
- Lifecycle — notes are marked `active`, `superseded` or `closed`, never
  deleted

- [Zed](https://zed.dev/) or [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md/) for a nicer
